**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Replace the false workflow-input threat control**

When this task edits `.github/workflows/regime.yml`, the residual control incorrectly claims that no workflow file is in `allowed_files`, although line 8 explicitly allows that workflow. The change also begins consuming `github.base_ref` to select a mutable run-time ref, but this row neither analyzes that input nor names a control validating that it resolves only to the trusted base branch; replace the false rationale with a control and test that cover the new ref-selection boundary.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/538a9b762ff9c58202fd6f3b15f6224617c5ad62/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
